title: Men Don't Leave
description: An indebted widow (Jessica Lange) sells the family home and starts over with her two sons (Chris O'Donnell, Charlie Korsmo) in Baltimore.

title: The Year of Living Dangerously
description: An Australian reporter (Mel Gibson) betrays his friend (Linda Hunt) and his lover (Sigourney Weaver) in volatile 1965 Indonesia.

title: National Lampoon's Loaded Weapon 1
description: A murdered policewoman's replacement (Emilio Estevez) continues a cocaine-cookie case with her ex-partner (Samuel L. Jackson).

title: Rumor Has It
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) sets out to find the truth after learning that the movie "The Graduate" may have been based on her family.

title: Death to Smoochy
description: Fired from his children's show, a former star (Robin Williams) tries to kill his replacement, a man (Edward Norton) dressed in a rhinoceros suit.

title: Boiler Room
description: Eager to win the approval of his demanding father, a young man (Giovanni Ribisi) begins working for a dubious stock firm.

title: Fandango
description: A prankster (Kevin Costner), an ROTC student (Judd Nelson) and their buddies hop in a Cadillac for one last fling in 1971 Texas.

title: Mr. Wonderful
description: If a man (Matt Dillon) finds his ex-wife (Annabella Sciorra) a husband, he can then put her alimony toward his bowling-alley dream.

title: The Majestic
description: Residents of a 1950s coastal community mistake an amnesiac screenwriter for a soldier who never returned from the war.

title: Joe Versus the Volcano
description: A dying man (Tom Hanks) meets three women (Meg Ryan) on his way to Polynesia, where a tycoon (Lloyd Bridges) expects him to jump into a volcano.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: Fathers' Day
description: Two Californians (Robin Williams, Billy Crystal) seek a former girlfriend's missing son, each believing he is the father of the boy.

title: Preacher's Kid
description: A smooth-talking singer convinces a young woman (LeToya Luckett) to leave the security of her family, friends and church to join a traveling gospel show.

title: Alex & Me
description: Teenager Reagan Wills dreams of playing soccer like Alex Morgan, her hero. A poster of the soccer star magically comes to life in Reagan's bedroom, and Alex helps Reagan learn the value of determination.

title: The Dukes of Hazzard: The Beginning
description: Bo (Jonathan Bennett), Luke (Randy Wayne) and Daisy Duke try to prevent Boss Hogg from seizing Uncle Jesse's (Willie Nelson) farm.

title: City by the Sea
description: A New York homicide detective (Robert De Niro) searches for his son (James Franco), the prime suspect in the murder of a drug dealer.

title: My Sister's Keeper
description: A girl (Abigail Breslin) who was conceived as a marrow donor for her gravely ill sister goes to court to seek emancipation and prevent further harvesting of her body tissue.

title: Alex & Emma
description: A struggling writer (Luke Wilson) falls in love with a stenographer (Kate Hudson) while trying to finish his new novel in 30 days.

title: Strange Brew
description: The Canadian McKenzie brothers (Dave Thomas, Rick Moranis) cork a beer-factory brewmeister (Max von Sydow) who's out to rule the world.

title: The Accidental Tourist
description: A numb travel-writer (William Hurt) takes up with his dog trainer (Geena Davis) after his son dies and his wife (Kathleen Turner) leaves.

title: Protocol
description: A Washington waitress saves the Emir of Ohtar's life, launching her diplomatic career and a scandal.

title: Overnight Delivery
description: A college student must prevent an impending disaster when he erroneously sends a poison-pen letter to his girlfriend.

title: Nothing but Trouble
description: Four trendy New Yorkers face a crazed judge and other horrors in the village of Valkenvania.

title: Almost Heroes
description: A tracker (Chris Farley) and his entourage help a fop (Matthew Perry) try to beat Lewis & Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804.

title: Matchstick Men
description: After meeting his daughter (Alison Lohman) for the first time, a con man (Nicolas Cage) and his partner (Sam Rockwell) try to swindle a boorish businessman.

title: Alex & Emma
description: A struggling writer (Luke Wilson) falls in love with a stenographer (Kate Hudson) while trying to finish his new novel in 30 days.

title: Her Alibi
description: A mystery writer (Tom Selleck) provides an alibi and a bedroom for a Romanian beauty (Paulina Porizkova) suspected of murder.

title: Victor/Victoria
description: A Chicago mobster falls for a female impersonator, actually a woman, in the 1930s Paris.

title: Grilled
description: Two down-on-their-luck meat salesmen (Ray Romano, Kevin James) land in hot water when their "foolproof" scheme backfires.

title: Wildcats
description: A famous coach's daughter (Goldie Hawn) coaches boys football at a city high school patrolled by dogs.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Red Sonja
description: A muscleman (Arnold Schwarzenegger) helps a swordswoman (Brigitte Nielsen) recover a talisman from a bad queen (Sandahl Bergman).

title: 16 Blocks
description: A boozy, world-weary NYPD cop (Bruce Willis) must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness (Mos Def) who is set to testify against them.

title: Love Affair
description: Engaged to others, a man (Warren Beatty) and a woman (Annette Bening) on a plane plan to meet again three months later atop the Empire State Building.

title: Arthur 2: On the Rocks
description: Arthur's (Dudley Moore) wife (Liza Minnelli) goes back to work when the tippling Park Avenue heir loses his money and hits Skid Row.

title: Spies Like Us
description: Two clumsy bureaucrats (Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd) are trained as spies, then sent to Pakistan to create a diversion.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: Ladyhawke
description: A medieval pickpocket (Matthew Broderick) learns the secret of a brooding knight (Rutger Hauer) with a hawk, and a beauty (Michelle Pfeiffer) with a wolf.

title: The Right Stuff
description: The selection and training of the first U.S. astronauts take place amid political maneuvering and media hype.

title: Addicted to Love
description: A man (Matthew Broderick) and a woman (Meg Ryan) meet by chance, then collaborate to spy on their exes, who are live-in lovers.

title: The Jacket
description: Cared for by a physician (Kris Kristofferson), an amnesiac Gulf War veteran (Adrien Brody) has violent flashbacks and visions of the future.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.
